predecessors.name: French Fifth Republic
predecessors.text: Middle Congo, which 'became known as the Republic of the Congo in 1958' (established 28 November 1958 as an autonomous colony within the French Community after French Equatorial Africa was dissolved)

ledger.x: 1960-08-15: the Republic of the Congo becomes independent.
1969-12-31: the People's Republic of the Congo is established.

1992-03-15: the People's Republic is disestablished and the state is again the Republic of the Congo, after the introduction of multi-party elections (infobox: 'Disestablishment of the People's Republic: 15 March 1992').
1998, last quarter: Ninja and Nsiloulou militias seize ground in the south.

wars.name: Republic of the Congo Civil War (1993-1994)
wars.outcome: 'In the years 1993 and 1994 the first Republic of the Congo Civil War occurred.'

wars.name: Republic of the Congo Civil War (1997-1999)
wars.outcome: Sassou Nguesso's victory: Lissouba, who had ordered the Cocoye to detain Sassou on 5 June 1997, was ousted in mid-October; the Cobra militia with 1,000 Angolan troops 'cemented their control' of Brazzaville on 16 October 1997 and Sassou assumed the presidency…

wars.name: Pool conflict (2002-2003 and 2016-2017)
wars.outcome: 'Fighting restarted in the Pool region' after the 2002 elections and a peace treaty was signed in April 2003; the Ninja rebels 'launched attacks against the army in April 2016' and a ceasefire deal was signed in December 2017.

certainty.note: Colonial frontiers: the Congo River with the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Angolan exclave of Cabinda to the south.

sources.title: Republic of the Congo Civil War (1997-1999)
